text:
$SNDK SanDisk CFO: Data center revenue grew 61% QoQ to $4.8B:

“Data center revenue was $4.8 billion, up 61% sequentially, outpacing estimated market growth for the quarter. Our leading products and strong customer partnerships, including three US hyperscalers, underpinned our continued expansion in this fast-growing end market.”
